svg.title: The flight instrument's five modes

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans Mono, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: FLT shows one mode at a time, chosen by the first that applies, top to bottom.

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans Mono, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: 1 DEPARTURE (docked)

svg.text: Rules for every mode

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans Mono, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: Same zone, same size class: modes swap, they don't stack.

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans Mono, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: Frame: locked target, else a dock target in range, else orbit.

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans Mono, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: dv is always 'left' against 'what home takes' (Navigation).

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans Mono, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: A mode's keys appear only in the mode, never in the hint line too.

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans Mono, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: Gunnery: FLT hides; HLM (who flies, what order) takes its place.

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans Mono, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: DOCK: the target card keeps identity only; numbers are FLT's.

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans Mono, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: Mode order is a priority list: docked beats everything; a dock approach beats a burn (a burn

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans Mono, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: planned while docking waits); a burn beats warp (warp drops out for it); warp beats cruise.
